title: NextAllocSkillContract
description: Proposed shared skill contract decoupling lexical equivalence, evidence provenance, and policy eligibility.

conceptId.description: Unique URI or URN identifying the canonical skill concept

canonicalName.description: Authorized canonical display name in NextAlloc taxonomy

rawInput.description: Exact text or token provided by candidate or extracted from document

relationType.description: Lexical relationship between raw input and canonical catalog

isLexicallyEquivalent.description: True strictly for EXACT_CANONICAL and unambiguous VERIFIED_ALIAS. False for related tools, sub-disciplines, composites, and out-of-scope skills. DOES NOT imply policy eligibility.

taxonomyVersion.description: Semantic version of the authoritative skill catalog

evidenceStatus.description: Verification status of underlying evidence. Distinct from lexical validation.

proposedSoftWeight.description: Uncalibrated candidate fractional weight for soft suitability research (subject to empirical tuning)

taxonomyGap.description: True if skill is a valid occupational skill outside current prototype taxonomy

sectorAttribution.description: Economic sector for out-of-scope skills (e.g. Food Processing, Agriculture, Manufacturing)
